notes.title: 💀 Slaycation Paradise's new massive free update arrives on December 12th!
notes.content:
Ready to slay away your worries in the new survival mode? [b]JUST 5 DAYS TO GO! [/b] 
 
Slaycation Paradise’s [b]new big content update[/b] launches into Steam on [b]December 12th!  [/b]

Here's what you can expect:

[b]NEW SURVIVAL MODE[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42149820/d7d7c71b641d419c3c7239a181de59b15dfc1e12.jpg[/img]

Kick back and relax with five new destinations in the desperate, hopeless lands of the omniverse and endure wave after wave of aliens, zombies, lobotomized cows, and of course, sentient blow-up dolls. Construct your perfect getaway with a wide arsenal of structures from stasis cores to electri-fryers…there’s fun for the whole family! But if a more… ‘intimate’… vacation is what you need to unwind, then kit yourself out with a vast array of perks that will compliment your loadout of intergalactic weaponry spanning from paddles to spider-drone launchers.  

[b]NEW PERK SYSTEM[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42149820/ae8d6d0b7994ebf532d7ed32067d390ec8bea40f.jpg[/img]

What do intoxication, regeneration, and evisceration all have in common? They’re the three things you’ll need to survive and enjoy yourself! Most importantly, regeneration, -one of the many perks that you can choose from as the hordes drop at your feet! The new mode features a new perk system with dozens of fine, aged selections that can increase your carnage catharsis!

[b]NEW MAPS[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42149820/550c20c838288c69c04208aec6e329e287d1bfdb.jpg[/img]

Have you ever put your legs up on a beach and thought “I’d rather be in hell, killing demons” -Neither, have we! But a beach and hell are just two of the five travel destinations to soak in the rays, whether they be from the Sun or alien assault rifles!

[b]NEW WEAPONS[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42149820/9548a929652586a211c574b0a6d264da903252dd.jpg[/img]

Now it wouldn’t be complete and utter planetary annihilation without the latest and greatest machinations that spread defilement and decimation at your fingertips! Would it? Featuring the new Groper and Poundinator! No, that’s not the name of the two big scary guys at the Paradise bar, those are the brand new weapons at your disposal that tear apart your foes with a twisting mass of tentacles and incinerate their twitching corpses with a bombardment of inter-planetary missiles!

notes.title: Hot Fix 2
notes.content:
[h1]Hot Fix 2 - Quality of Life Improvements[/h1]
This one's a bit more than just a hot fix -- there's a bunch of improvements and even a few new things in there...

[b]FIXES:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where blueprints didn't unlock reliably.
[*] Fixed a balance bug where higher rarity drops weren't respecting the loot table rules.
[*] Fixed 12 text legibility issues for Japanese, Russian, Chinese (Traditional), and Spanish languages.
[*] Resolved a rare but annoying soft-lock bug when killing two bosses at the exact same time.
[/list]


[b]BALANCE:[/b]
[list]
[*] Minor buffs for a few under-utilised weapons.
[*] Increased challenge on higher difficulties. You should definitely feel it...
[*] ...but also increased item drop and rarity rate to counter this. Higher difficulty = better and MORE loot.
[*] Nerfed the wand output damage...
[*] ...but increased its inherent Corpse explosion damage. Bigger risk/reward payoff, but harder to solo it.
[*] Tweaked the blueprint drop rate rules to make it a more fair experience, and less purely random.
[/list]


[b]NEW:[/b]
[list]
[*] To promote fresh weapons, added an upgrade limit on the number of levels you can invest into a weapon.
[*] Added the ability to extinguish some status effects when dodge-rolling. Corrosion/poison/burn/etc.
[*] Added a secret easter-egg. It's dumb and tiny and I don't recommend trying to find it.
[/list]

notes.title: Slaycation Paradise - OUT NOW
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Cc7-LiucpfA;full][/previewyoutube]

Dive into the heart of the action constructing elaborate custom defense systems and wild, unexpected weaponry as you tear through hordes of enemies. Knock back a drink from the bar and let loose. Plow through everything from traditional zombie apocalypses to swathes of deranged lucha libres, on a series of unstable and dangerous alternate Earths - rigged for your pleasure. 

Time for a getaway? Here at ApocaTrips, our expert team of travel agents nestled deep in the heart of the galaxy are ready and waiting to warp you away to the trans-dimensional action scenario of a lifetime.  

Explore beautiful and chaotic holiday destinations with an all-inclusive arsenal of bizarre and brutal weapons for that fully loaded firepower feeling! Kick back and slay all your worries away with Slaycation Paradise! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1643850/Slaycation_Paradise/

[b]FEATURES: [/b]

[b]Twin-stick Shooting & Tower Defense[/b]! – Taking the best of each genre to create an engaging and addictive gameplay loop where hordes of bloodthirsty enemies are waiting to welcome you to the party!  
 

[b]Apocalypse A-plenty![/b] – Discover alternate Earths all going through crazy End-of-Days type scenarios perfectly designed for the best in family vacation entertainment.  
 

[b]Weird & Wonderful Weapons![/b] – Enjoy an apocalypse-proof weapon selection from the classic pump shotgun and flamethrower to the weird and wonderful cat-launcher, magic wands and many more. 
 

[b]Tailor Your Very Own Tower Defense Set-up[/b] - Free to all visitors is the simply swell Construction Assembly Turret (C.A.T. kit), providing custom defense structures anywhere you like. Perfect for all your defensive needs against those pesky zombie hordes! Your C.A.T. kit will provide you and your loved ones with a heightened level of security and ensure you enjoy every moment of your stay at the end of days. 
 

[b]Earn Slaycation Club Member’s Rewards[/b] - We like to give back to our members here at Slaycation Paradise. While touring with us, you'll earn Slaycation Club Rewards, allowing you to unlock crazy new weapons and wonderful upgrade perks. Only the best will do for our valued customers!

notes.title: How the get the most out of your SlayCation
notes.content:
Hey there slaycationers!

Here at Slaycation Paradise we always want to make sure you have the best family slaying trips possible, so we put together a short guide on how to get the most out of your trips!

[h1]Fail to prepare, prepare to fail![/h1]

Be sure to head over to the Stash 'n' Dash before your trip to browse our exciting catalogue of apocalypse-proof weapons guaranteed to bring a smile to every family trip.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42149820/77c3e419d90f626a3414c257e697cde9e8e493e1.png[/img]

[h1]Get the lay of the land[/h1]

Once your portal jockey sends you packing on your next fun slaycation trip, the first thing you'll want to do is take in the sights! Slaycation Paradise is the gateway to a whole host of interesting apocalypse locales filled with scrap to be gathered and put to good use! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42149820/5f0ab2548da666946f0a83ded516bb37d6a8fc12.png[/img]

You can also get the lay of the land and make some important decisions on where to place your fortifications!

[h1]Get creative![/h1]

Our patented Construction Assembly Kit (C.A.T) comes as standard with every slaycation trip and puts at your fingertips everything you need to survive your trip. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42149820/ac8b1b8f358287ca630b7fce0a08ade68b6d0bc7.png[/img]

So don't leave all the scrap burning a hole in your pocket, put it to good use with the C.A.T and make sure you return from your trip in one piece.

[h1]Meet the locals[/h1]

Immerse yourself in the local culture! The locals of each destination will be dying to get much, much better acquainted with you and give your slaycation that edge of thrill, adventure & danger! So get out there to say hello and keep that finger on the trigger!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42149820/56b0470b3a37174a6b916e7c69943fb3bacd11d7.png[/img]

notes.title: Slaycation Paradise at GDC!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We've been so excited to finally share Slaycation Paradise with you and it was great to announce the game in the MIX 10th Anniversary Showcase at GDC 2022!

Whilst some of the Merge team were over in San Francisco for GDC, it was a great opportunity to put Slaycation Paradise on the press radar and run some private hands-on preview sessions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42149820/cadbd7a11235cee74903ad8490b5b2417d4a022d.jpg[/img]

After being away from physical events for so long, it was a delight to get back on the ground and meet players at the MIX Developers Showcase. We put Slaycation Paradise on the show floor and players could get a very first hands-on demo of the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42149820/59f2bf8951376287bb4b507e6b66b48b876ba79b.jpg[/img]

Some of the feedback we got from players in person was that they found the controls & tower-defence options to be very intuitive and they loved the lighting of the level they played!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42149820/41eec18f8d5738b9b961ea29853015c752b229c4.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Welcome to Slaycation Paradise
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We’re super excited to welcome you to the vacation destination of the future, welcome to [b]Slaycation Paradise[/b]!

[previewyoutube=N_weLzZxjjI;full][/previewyoutube]

When the same [i]boring old[/i] vacation destinations just don’t do it for you anymore, and you need a trip with a bit more [b]excitement[/b], then Slaycation Paradise is the holiday destination for you!

Slaycation Paradise is a [b]twin-stick, tower defence[/b] action trip through a variety of colourful alternate Earths and a wild mix of deadly enemies.

At Slaycation Paradise you can:

[list]
[*] Travel to a range of unique & exotic apocalyptic locations to experience a selection of alternate earth annihilation scenarios. 

[*] Tailor your own tower defence set-up and survive against hordes of bloodthirsty creatures – fun for all the family!

[*] Get your hands on a range of weapons from classics like the pump-action shotgun to futuristic weapons like the cat-launcher! 
[/list]

Be sure to add Slaycation Paradise to your [b]wishlist[/b]!
